{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows recent negative drift.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp upward spikes in price (especially after 70+ peaks).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome is consistently below 65.00 over 3 consecutive days.",
    "If sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0) and forecast is below 60.00, consider upward adjustment by 2-5%.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is 2-3 days ahead of forecast, adjust forecast to align with recent 5-day moving average.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early 30-day forecasts — reduce initial forecast by 3-5% if sentiment is neutral or negative."
  ]
}
